title: DECISION: receiptSharing default true for backward compatibility
description: PresenceStatus.receiptSharing defaults to true (receipts enabled). This is correct for backward compatibility: federation peers and existing implementations that predate this field expect read receipts to flow by default. A default of false would silently break existing read receipt flows for any deployment that upgrades to support this field without explicitly setting it. Opt-out (default true, user turns off) is also the conventional pattern for social protocols where read receipts have historically been the norm — iMessage, WhatsApp, Signal all default receipts on. The privacy-preserving direction (false) is available, but the user must affirmatively choose it, consistent with the principle of not silently changing existing behavior.
